description: Single-column, ATS-optimized linear resume. No sidebar, headshot, tables, text boxes, floating objects or columns. Conventional section headings, standard bullets, readable fonts and fully selectable/searchable text. ATS parser-oriented profile, skills, software and education labels are included in the verified sections so portal systems can extract the same facts exposed by the canonical master ATS CV.

route_recommendation.note: Both templates are always generated and retained. Exactly one CV is selected per application: ATS Linear by default for portals and Modern Executive Sidebar by default for email, unless the persisted preview override selects the other variant. Email drafts attach only that selected CV PDF.

page_limit_note: ATS integrity and complete relevant chronology take precedence over forcing the page count; a 3-page result is accepted with a warning finding.
body_alignment_note: Deliberate ATS-optimization deviation from the global justified-body writing rule; left alignment avoids the uneven inter-word spacing that some ATS parsers mis-read.
